description: Per-file delivery activity (GET /v1/usage/delivery) over a range. Default group_by=output answers "how many preview/demo plays vs real track plays" (output_index values like preview vs hq/lq). Also groups by collection, track, creator, or day; group_by=none returns a summary plus a day/month time series. Returns requests, bytes, cache hit/miss split (requests_cached / requests_uncached), rejected signed URLs (requests_failed), and origin delivery cost (requests_uncached × cost_plays/1000). Counts are edge delivery activity (adaptive-sampled, inflated by audio range requests) — not a literal play count; use adn_get_plays for play sessions. Default delivery zone only. Requires a full API Access key. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_get_delivery
